question: Mazboot password banane ka behtareen tareeqa kya hai?
options: Apna naam aur birth year likhein
Kam az kam 12 characters, numbers aur symbols ka mix
explanation: Mazboot password lamba hona chahiye aur usme letters, numbers aur special characters hone chahiye, taake use guess karna mushkil ho.

question: Agar aapko kisi 'Bank' se call aaye aur wo aapka OTP maange, to aapko kya karna chahiye?
options: Call kaat kar bank ki official helpline par rabta karna chahiye
Unhe theek OTP ke bajaye ghalat OTP batana chahiye
explanation: Bank kabhi bhi call par aapka OTP ya password nahi maangta. Call kaat dein aur tasdeeq ke liye official number par call karein.

question: Public WiFi (jaise cafe ka free WiFi) istemal karte waqt kya nahi karna chahiye?
options: Banking app check karna ya online shopping karna
explanation: Free WiFi mehfooz nahi hote. Hackers aapka data chori kar sakte hain. Aise network par hassas maloomat (banking) share na karein.

question: Phishing SMS ko kaise pehchanein?
options: Isme amuman inam ka lalach ya dara kar link par click karne ko kaha jata hai
Wo hamesha Urdu mein hota hai
explanation: Phishing messages amuman emergency ya bari offer dikha kar aap se maloomat lene ki koshish karte hain. Aise links hargiz na kholein.

question: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) ka kya faida hai?
options: Internet speed tez ho jati hai
Account login karne par ek izafi security layer lag jati hai (jaise OTP)
Is se mobile battery bachti hai
explanation: 2FA aapke account ko dogna mehfooz banata hai, kyunke password hack hone ke bawajood bhi login ke liye OTP zaroori hota hai.

question: Koi app agar aisi permission maange jo uske kaam ki na ho (jaise Calculator app Contacts mange), to kya karein?
options: Deny karein aur zaroorat pade to uninstall karein
explanation: Baghair zaroorat permissions dene se aapka private data chori ho sakta hai. Ehtiyat karein.

question: Social media par 'Public' profile rakhne ka kya nuqsan hai?
options: Koi bhi anjaan shakhs aapki tasveerein aur maloomat dekh aur chori kar sakta hai
Internet data kam use hota hai
explanation: Public accounts ka data scammers asani se utha kar fake IDs bana sakte hain ya blackmail kar sakte hain. Privacy zaroori hai.

question: Agar WhatsApp par dost ka message aaye ke 'Mujhe 5000 rs bhej do, emergency hai', to behtar aqdam kya hai?
options: Uske number par normal call kar ke tasdeeq karein ke wohi baat kar raha hai
explanation: Ho sakta hai aapke dost ka account hack ho gaya ho. Hamesha direct call kar ke tasdeeq karni chahiye.

question: Apne software ya apps ko update karna kyun zaroori hai?
options: Naye security flaws (kamzoriyon) ko theek karne ke liye
Phone ka color change karne ke liye
Mobile ki speed double karne ke liye
explanation: Updates mein security patches hote hain jo aapke phone ko naye virus aur hackers se bachate hain.

question: HTTPS mein 'S' ka kya matlab hai (jaise https://www.google.com)?
explanation: Secure hone ka matlab hai ke aapka data aur website ke darmian connection encrypted (mehfooz) hai.

question: Agar raste mein aapko ek USB (flash drive) mili, to aapko kya karna chahiye?
options: Fauran laptop mein laga kar dekhein
Apne computer mein hargiz na lagayein, isme virus ho sakta hai
explanation: Anjaan USB mein viruses ya malware ho sakte hain jo lagate hi aapke system ko tabah ya hack kar sakte hain.

question: Mera password kitne arsay baad tabdeel karna chahiye?
options: Jab mehsoos ho ke account hack hone ka dar ho ya kisi aur device mein khula reh gaya ho
explanation: Password tabdeel karte rehna achi aadat hai, khaas tor par jab kisi nayi device par login kiya ho.

question: Spam Emails kya hoti hain?
options: Ghair zaroori, dhoka dahi wali ya ishtehaari emails jo lakho ki tadad mein bheji jati hain
explanation: Spam emails aksar scams ya virus walay links par mabni hoti hain, inhen nahi kholna chahiye.

question: Agar koi website kehti hai 'Aapka phone virus se mutasir hai, abhi antivirus download karein', to ye kya hai?
options: Scareware (dara kar app install karwane ka dhoka)
explanation: Websites automatically check nahi kar saktin ke phone mein virus hai ya nahi. Ye ads dhoka dene ke liye hote hain.

question: Social Engineering ka kya matlab hai?
options: Insaan ki nafsiyat (dar, lalach) se khel kar maloomat nikalwana
explanation: Hackers technology se zyada insaan ke damagh se khailte hain, jaise emergency ka jhuta natak kar ke OTP lena.
